notes: Added a notification center with unread badge and lightweight in-app toasts.
Startup update checks now appear as a notification instead of interrupting your workflow.
Redesigned the update prompt with a cleaner changelog-focused layout.
Added smarter download recovery plus Pause all, Resume all and Retry failed controls.
Added release recommendation scoring with preferred and blocked release groups.
Added recent search history for one-click repeat searches.
Improved the pre-download review with clearer disk and conflict information.
Added portable settings export/import without API keys.
Added an About & Updates view with version, update status and changelog.
Added previous-crash detection and diagnostics notification.
